title: RightTon house file
description: A house described for heating and cooling load calculation. US units only; every quantity carries its unit in its field name. Version 1.1.

format_version.description: Version of this format the file was written for, as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. This schema is 1.1.0. Readers accept any 1.x file.

project.description: About the project. Never put a street address, an owner's name or other personal details here.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

bedroom_count.description: Number of bedrooms. Only used to default the number of occupants (bedrooms + 1).

location.description: Where the house is, as a weather station. There is no address field.

weather_station_id.description: WMO number of the weather station, as text (e.g. "725650"). Supplies design conditions; see the station list in docs/FORMAT.md. Optional if design_conditions gives everything marked 'needed without a station'.

design_conditions.description: Design conditions. Each value given here overrides the weather station's.

heating_outdoor_temp_f.description: Outdoor temperature the heating system must cope with (99 % design drybulb). Needed without a station.

cooling_outdoor_temp_f.description: Outdoor temperature the cooling system must cope with (1 % design drybulb). Needed without a station.

daily_temp_range.description: Typical summer day-night temperature swing: "low" (under 16 F), "medium" (16 to 25 F), "high" (over 25 F). Needed without a station.

humidity_difference_gr_lb.description: Outdoor minus indoor moisture content at cooling design conditions, in grains of water per pound of dry air. Negative in dry climates. Needed without a station.

latitude_deg.description: Latitude, positive north. Needed without a station.

elevation_ft.description: Elevation above sea level. Default 0 without a station.

cooling_indoor_humidity_frac.description: Indoor relative humidity in summer, as a fraction. Default 0.5 (0.45 in dry climates).

cooling_outdoor_humidity_ratio_lb_lb.description: Moisture content of outdoor air at cooling design, pounds of water per pound of dry air. Used for duct loads.

weather_shielding_factor.description: ASHRAE 62.2 weather and shielding factor of the station (no unit, about 0.4 to 0.7).

assemblies.description: Library of constructions (walls, roofs, ceilings, floors), each defined once and used by id from surfaces.

items.description: One construction. Give either layers (R-value is calculated, air films added automatically) or r_value_hr_ft2_f_btu for the whole assembly.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

type.description: What the assembly is used for. It sets which air films are added.

r_value_hr_ft2_f_btu.description: R-value of the whole assembly INCLUDING air films, when layers are not given.

layers.description: Layers from the inside face to the outside face. Do not include air films.

items.description: One layer, listed from the inside face to the outside face. Give material (with thickness_in unless the material has a fixed R-value), or r_per_inch_hr_ft2_f_btu_in with thickness_in, or r_value_hr_ft2_f_btu.

material.description: Id of a material in the materials list (docs/FORMAT.md), which supplies the R-value per inch.

r_value_hr_ft2_f_btu.description: R-value of the whole layer (e.g. a rated batt or an air space).

framing_material.description: For a framed layer: id of the material of the framing members (usually softwood).

framing_r_per_inch_hr_ft2_f_btu_in.description: For a framed layer: R per inch of the framing members, as an alternative to framing_material.

framing_frac.description: Share of the area taken up by framing members, for assemblies with a framed layer. Overrides the share calculated from framing (lumber and spacing). Without either, 0. Typical: 0.23 for 2x4 walls at 16 in o.c., 0.20 for 2x6 walls at 24 in, 0.10 to 0.13 for floors and ceilings.

framing.description: For assemblies with a framed layer: lumber size and spacing, from which RightTon works out the framing share (member width / spacing, plus a typical allowance for plates, headers, corners and window framing) and the cavity depth. Added in format 1.1. framing_frac, when given, overrides the calculated share.

lumber.description: Nominal lumber size of the studs, joists or rafters. Actual sizes: 2x4 = 1.5 x 3.5 in, 2x6 = 1.5 x 5.5, 2x8 = 1.5 x 7.25, 2x10 = 1.5 x 9.25, 2x12 = 1.5 x 11.25, 4x4 = 3.5 x 3.5. "custom" needs width_in and depth_in.

width_in.description: Actual member width (the face that interrupts the cavity), when it differs from the nominal size (e.g. old full-dimension lumber, 2 in) or lumber is "custom".

depth_in.description: Actual member depth, which is the cavity depth, when it differs from the nominal size or lumber is "custom".

spacing_in.description: On-center spacing of the members: usually 12, 16, 19.2 or 24.

allowance_frac.description: Extra framing share for plates, headers, corners, blocking and window/door framing. Default: derived from the reference engine's typical framing factors (about 0.137 for walls, 0.037 for floors and ceilings, 0.0075 for roofs).

construction.description: Walls: structural type, used to estimate how slowly the wall passes summer heat. Default "wood_stud".

cladding.description: Walls: exterior finish. Only "brick" and "stone" change the calculation. Default "wood".

solar_absorptance_frac.description: Walls: share of sunlight the exterior absorbs: about 0.3 white, 0.5 light, 0.7 medium, 0.9 dark. Default 0.7.

radiant_barrier.description: Roofs: true if there is a radiant barrier under the roof deck.

glazings.description: Library of window glazings entered from labels or data sheets, each defined once and used by id from windows (glazing). Added in format 1.1.

items.description: One glazing, usually copied from a window's NFRC label. Use whole-window values (the label's U-factor and Solar Heat Gain Coefficient), not center-of-glass values from a glass brochure.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

name.description: Name shown to people (e.g. the product line).

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

u_factor_btu_hr_ft2_f.description: Whole-window U-factor from the NFRC label.

shgc.description: Whole-window Solar Heat Gain Coefficient from the NFRC label (0 to 1, no unit).

glass_layers.description: Number of panes, if known (used to pick interior-shading factors).

source.description: Where the values came from (e.g. "NFRC label", a product data sheet).

zones.description: Zones: groups of rooms served and controlled together (one thermostat). At least one.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

heating_setpoint_f.description: Winter indoor temperature for this zone, if different from the house.

cooling_setpoint_f.description: Summer indoor temperature for this zone, if different from the house.

radiant_floor_heat.description: True if the zone is heated by a radiant floor.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

zone.description: Id of the zone this room belongs to.

occupant_count.description: People in the room at the cooling peak. If no room gives this, a house total is assumed and shared by floor area.

internal_sensible_gain_btu_hr.description: Heat from appliances and lighting in this room at the cooling peak. If no room gives this, a house total is assumed and shared by floor area.

internal_latent_gain_btu_hr.description: Moisture load from appliances in this room, as heat. Default 0.

below_grade.description: True if the room is in a conditioned basement.

infiltration_share_frac.description: Share of whole-house air leakage assigned to this room. If any room has one, shares are used (they are scaled to add to 1); otherwise leakage is shared by exposed wall area.

outline_ft.description: Optional floor outline for CAD tools: list of [x, y] or [x, y, z] points in feet. Not used by the engine.

spaces.description: Spaces that are not lived-in rooms: attics, crawlspaces, unconditioned basements, garages, porches, and conditioned-but-unoccupied spaces such as a sealed attic.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

type.description: Kind of space. "conditioned": inside the insulation and air barrier but not lived in (e.g. a sealed, roof-insulated attic); it must name a zone. "open_porch": open to outdoor air but shaded. "custom": temperature set by the weights or design temperatures below.

zone.description: For type "conditioned": the zone whose system conditions it.

volume_ft3.description: Air volume. Default: estimated from the space's floor or roof surfaces.

vent_area_per_floor_area_frac.description: Vented attics and crawlspaces: net vent area divided by floor area. Default 1/300 (attic), 1/150 (crawlspace).

vent_air_changes_per_hr.description: Vented attics: air changes per hour, as an alternative to vent area.

heating_design_temp_f.description: Override: temperature of the space at the heating design condition.

cooling_design_temp_f.description: Override: temperature of the space at the cooling design condition.

indoor_weight_frac.description: Type "custom": weight of indoor temperature in the space temperature.

min_temp_f.description: Type "custom": the space never gets colder than this.

duct_regain_frac.description: Type "custom": share of duct losses in this space that return to the house.

surfaces.description: Walls, roofs, ceilings, floors and slabs: of rooms, and of unconditioned spaces (an attic's roof, a crawlspace's walls and floor).

type.description: Always "wall" for this kind of surface.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

inside.description: Id of the room (or unconditioned space) this surface belongs to. For a wall of a room, the room. For the roof over an attic, the attic space.

area_ft2.description: Gross area, including any windows, doors or skylights set into it.

outline_ft.description: Optional polygon outline for CAD tools and 3D views: list of [x, y, z] points in feet. The engine uses area_ft2, not this.

outside.description: What is on the other side: "outdoors", "ground", "adiabatic" (no heat flow, e.g. a party wall), the id of an unconditioned space, or the id of another room (a partition between rooms; it only matters when the two rooms are in zones with different setpoints). Default "outdoors".

assembly.description: Id of an entry in assemblies that describes the construction.

azimuth_deg.description: Compass direction the outside of the surface faces: 0 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west.

oneOf.description: Rim (band) joist around a floor frame. Calculated like a wood-framed wall.

type.description: Always "rim_joist" for this kind of surface.

Default "outdoors".

assembly.description: Optional. Id of an assembly giving the whole-wall R-value. If absent, the wall is built from material, thickness_in and the insulation fields.

azimuth_deg.description: Compass direction the outside of the surface faces: 0 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west.

depth_below_grade_ft.description: How much of the height is below the outside ground level.

length_ft.description: Optional wall length. Default: area_ft2 / height_ft.

interior_insulation.description: Continuous insulation on the inside face.

distance_to_top_ft.description: Distance from the top of the wall down to the top of the insulation.

distance_to_bottom_ft.description: Distance from the top of the wall down to the bottom of the insulation.

exterior_insulation.description: Continuous insulation on the outside face.

distance_to_top_ft.description: Distance from the top of the wall down to the top of the insulation.

distance_to_bottom_ft.description: Distance from the top of the wall down to the bottom of the insulation.

type.description: Always "roof" for this kind of surface.

pitch_rise_per_12.description: Roof pitch as inches of rise per 12 inches of run (6 means 6-in-12). 0 is flat. Default 6.

exposed_perimeter_ft.description: Length of slab edge exposed to outdoor air or ground (not edges shared with other conditioned space).

thickness_in.description: Slab thickness. Default 4. Use 0 for a dirt floor.

perimeter_insulation.description: Vertical insulation at the slab edge.

width_ft.description: Width of the insulated band in from the edge.

whole_slab.description: True if the whole slab is insulated underneath.

exterior_horizontal_insulation.description: Horizontal insulation wing outside the foundation.

openings.description: Windows, doors and skylights, each set into a surface.

type.description: Always "window" for this kind of opening.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

count.description: How many identical units this entry stands for. Default 1.

area_ft2.description: Area of ONE unit (rough opening). Give this, or width_ft and height_ft.

surface.description: Id of the wall (or foundation wall) the window is in.

azimuth_deg.description: Direction the window faces. Default: the wall's azimuth_deg.

glazing.description: Id of a glazing in this file's glazings library, or of a glazing preset (see the glazing list in docs/FORMAT.md). Used when u_factor_btu_hr_ft2_f and shgc are not given on the window itself. A library entry with the same id as a preset wins.

shgc.description: Solar heat gain coefficient (0 to 1, no unit).

glass_layers.description: Number of panes, if known (used to pick interior-shading factors).

storm_window.description: Storm window added over the unit. Default "none".

interior_shading.description: Blinds, shades or curtains inside the window. Leave out for none.

type.description: Kind and color of the shading.

coverage_frac.description: Share of the window covered in summer. Default 0.5.

coefficient_frac.description: Alternative to type: shading coefficient entered directly (1 = no shading).

exterior_shading.description: Shading outside the glass other than an overhang.

coefficient_frac.description: For type "other": share of solar gain that still gets through (1 = no shading).

coverage_frac.description: Share of the window covered. Default 1.

overhang.description: Roof overhang, porch roof or awning above the window.

depth_ft.description: How far it projects out from the wall.

distance_to_window_top_ft.description: Vertical distance from the overhang down to the top of the glass.

distance_to_window_bottom_ft.description: Vertical distance from the overhang down to the bottom of the glass.

type.description: Always "door" for this kind of opening.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

count.description: How many identical units this entry stands for. Default 1.

area_ft2.description: Area of ONE unit (rough opening). Give this, or width_ft and height_ft.

surface.description: Id of the wall the door is in.

type.description: Always "skylight" for this kind of opening.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

count.description: How many identical units this entry stands for. Default 1.

area_ft2.description: Area of ONE unit (rough opening). Give this, or width_ft and height_ft.

surface.description: Id of the roof the skylight is in.

azimuth_deg.description: Direction the roof slope faces. Default: the roof's azimuth_deg.

shgc.description: Solar heat gain coefficient (0 to 1, no unit).

storm_window.description: Storm window added over the unit. Default "none".

ceiling.description: If the roof is over an attic: id of the ceiling surface the light shaft comes through.

interior_shading_coefficient_frac.description: Shading coefficient of any interior shade (1 = none).

air.description: Air leakage, mechanical ventilation and ducts.

infiltration.description: Air leakage of the whole house. Give a blower-door result if there is one.

method.description: "blower_door": a measured (or estimated) leakage number is given below. "leakiness_estimate": only a description is given.

air_changes_per_hr_at_50pa.description: Blower-door result as ACH50: air changes per hour at 50 pascals (or at test_pressure_pa).

airflow_cfm_at_50pa.description: Blower-door result as CFM50: airflow at 50 pascals (or at test_pressure_pa).

natural_air_changes_per_hr.description: Alternative: annual-average natural air changes per hour.

leakage_area_in2.description: Alternative: effective leakage area at 4 Pa.

volume_ft3.description: Blower door: volume the test was normalized by. Leakiness estimate: above-grade conditioned volume. Default: sum of room (and conditioned space) volumes.

height_ft.description: Height from the lowest to the highest point of the leaky envelope. Only needed with natural_air_changes_per_hr.

shielding_class.description: Wind shielding: 1 = no obstructions, 3 = some, 4 = typical suburban (default), 5 = heavily shielded.

stories_above_grade.description: Number of conditioned stories above grade. Default 1.

exterior_envelope_frac.description: Attached units: share of the tested envelope that faces outdoors. Default 1.

unit_height_above_grade_ft.description: Attached units and apartments: height of the unit's floor above the ground. Default 0.

site_shielding.description: Attached units above grade: how sheltered the site is from wind. Default "normal".

fireplace.description: True if there is an open fireplace (adds 20 cfm in winter).

ventilation.description: Whole-house mechanical ventilation fans that run continuously or on a schedule (not bath or kitchen spot fans).

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

hours_per_day_hr.description: Hours of operation per day. Default 24.

sensible_recovery_frac.description: ERV/HRV: share of the temperature difference recovered (apparent sensible effectiveness).

latent_recovery_frac.description: ERV: share of the moisture difference recovered.

ducts.description: Duct systems, one per HVAC system that has ducts.

items.description: The ducts of one HVAC system.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

system.description: Id of the hvac system these ducts belong to.

supply_leakage_cfm_at_25pa.description: Supply-side leakage to outside at 25 Pa.

return_leakage_cfm_at_25pa.description: Return-side leakage to outside at 25 Pa.

supply_leakage_frac.description: Alternative: supply leakage as a share of system airflow.

return_leakage_frac.description: Alternative: return leakage as a share of system airflow.

segments.description: Runs of duct, grouped by where they are.

items.description: Ducts of one kind in one location.

location.description: Where the ducts run: the id of a room or space, or "outdoors". Ducts in a room or a conditioned space lose nothing to outside.

surface_area_ft2.description: Duct surface area in this location.

share_of_ducts_frac.description: Alternative to surface_area_ft2: share of this system's supply (or return) ducts that is in this location; area is then estimated from the floor area served.

insulation_r_value_hr_ft2_f_btu.description: Nominal R-value printed on the duct insulation (0 for bare ducts). Converted to an effective value.

effective_r_value_hr_ft2_f_btu.description: Alternative: effective R-value including air films.

equipment.description: Heat-producing equipment reported on its own line in the results, e.g. a dehumidifier.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

room.description: Id of the room (or conditioned space) the heat goes into.

sensible_heat_btu_hr.description: Heat given off into the room while running at the cooling peak.

latent_heat_btu_hr.description: Moisture added to the room, as heat. Negative for moisture removed.

hvac.description: Heating and cooling systems. Equipment sizes are not inputs: the calculation says what is needed.

items.description: One heating and/or cooling system serving one zone.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

zone.description: Id of the zone this system serves.

heating_airflow_cfm_per_ton.description: Heating airflow per 12,000 Btu/h of load. Default 240 (furnace) or 360 (heat pump).

cooling_airflow_cfm_per_ton.description: Cooling airflow per 12,000 Btu/h of load. Default 360.

blower_heat_btu_hr.description: Heat added to the air by the blower motor in cooling. Default 0.

piping_loss_btu_hr.description: Hydronic systems: heat lost from piping outside the conditioned space. Default 0.

supply_registers.description: Ids of the rooms that have a supply register (or radiator, or indoor unit) of this system.

returns.description: Ids of the rooms that have a return grille.

scenarios.description: What-if variations, each a short list of changes against the baseline house above.

id.description: Unique id of this item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

notes.description: Free-form note. Never used in the calculation.

cost_usd.description: Cost the user enters for this scenario. RightTon never supplies prices.

includes.description: Ids of other scenarios whose changes are applied first, to stack scenarios.

path.description: Where: section/id/field, e.g. "surfaces/north-wall/assembly" or "air/infiltration/air_changes_per_hr_at_50pa". Nested fields continue the path: "openings/w1/overhang/depth_ft".

oneOf.description: Add an item to a section.

section.description: Section the item goes into, e.g. "openings" or "air/ventilation".

item.description: The complete new item, with its own id.

oneOf.description: Remove an item or a field.

extensions.description: Data owned by other tools, each under its own key (e.g. extensions.my-cad-tool). Readers must keep extensions they do not understand when re-saving.

id.description: An id: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter or digit. Unique across the whole file.

quantity.description: A number, or a number with where it came from.

source.description: Where the number came from (e.g. "blower door test, 2024", "tape measure").

confidence.description: How far to trust it. A bare number counts as "default".
